g.text: Extension capital per item for United States (USA), a FABIO-internal decomposition; the World Bank reference
is TOTAL-only, so no WB line is drawn. Taxes less subsidies is the production-side measure throughout. Blue
line/triangles on the Primary (ISIC-A) row(s) = external A01+A03 capital benchmark (OECD_SUT; exported by
scripts 02/03), a primary-agriculture, forestry-free reference for the covered years. Items grouped as
"Other" exactly as in the TOTAL figure (below 3% max |share| of WB across years). Rows: primary (ISIC-A) vs
COMBINED-EXIOBASE extension capital, United States (USA) (value-added sub-account)
